brief: Deletes items from a list: every occurrence of an item, the nth or the first or the last, the item at a position, a section, or several positions at once.
detail: It is the removing helper of stzList, which builds one over itself for its RemoveW method; build one with new stzListRemover when you only need to delete. It works on its own copy, so a stzList passed in is never changed, and you read the result with Content. A verb (RemoveAll, RemoveFirstItem, RemoveSection ...) edits the held list in place and returns nothing, its Q form returning the remover for chaining; the past-tense forms (AllOccurrencesRemoved, NthItemRemoved, FirstItemRemoved, LastItemRemoved) return an edited copy and leave the remover alone. Positions count from 1. Items are matched whole and with case; the CS forms take 0 to ignore case. Three limits found today: a negative position given to RemoveItemAtPosition (and so to RemoveAt, RemoveAtPosition and RemoveNthItem) kills the Ring process, RemoveLastItem raises on an empty list, and a position listed twice in RemoveItemsAtPositions deletes two different items.
